evidence.claim: Castlewood spent six years as an incorporated town, then reversed the decision. In 1991 it established a mayor and six-member council, seeking to attract industry after coal-mine losses by improving infrastructure.
evidence.quote: In 1991, Castlewood became an incorporated town with a mayor and a six member town council. The goal of incorporation was to bring industry to the area after the loss of coal mines by building up the infrastructure.

evidence.claim: New property taxes financed a town hall. Voters later elected a government that dismantled incorporation in 1997.
evidence.quote: A town hall was built, financed through the newly levied property taxes. The new taxation and police department were unpopular. The town elected a government to dismantle the incorporation, a feat which was accomplished in 1997.
